name: calc_capm
description:
Expected return under the Capital Asset Pricing Model: rf + beta * (market return - rf). Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {expected_return, risk_premium}: both percent, 4 decimals; risk_premium is the market premium (market return - rf).
Inputs (* required): risk_free_rate* (percent), beta* (number), market_return* (percent).
To estimate beta use calc_beta; country premia: fmp_market_risk_premium; to combine with debt calc_wacc.
Example: {"risk_free_rate": 4, "beta": 1.2, "market_return": 9}

beta.description: Beta of the asset against the market
